checks.retelling: P and D have different useful batches. Attention retains local request history while MoE gathers input rows at experts; wider EP reduces repeated ideal weight reads only with sufficient concurrency, and replicas trade resources for hotspot relief. Ready block inputs/results permit communication and compute overlap without bypassing dependencies. Shared KV reduces recomputation and relaxes placement, while P time budgets and D request/KV balance keep work suited to resources. The measured speed/throughput frontier and total fees per effective output constrain cost; educational read counts and public income do not establish real speedups or profit.
